task: Per real detected face (via the paired production face_detection model, insightface-buffalo-l-detect / SCRFD), FairFace's own predicted gender and age_bucket, graded against what a human can confidently assert from direct visual inspection alone: gender and 'this is not a child' - not exact age or ethnicity.
note:
Only one real, usable source image exists anywhere in this repo's committed fixtures with clearly visible human faces - stock_streetscene_3adults.jpg (already used by the intern-child-adult-detection manifest). Every other frame under backend/tests/fixtures/golden/ (the 7 real Autotek NVR night/interior frames, the 9 license-plate-detector vehicle photos) was checked directly and has no face at a resolution a face detector could use - checked by running the real SCRFD face_detection model against each, not assumed. This is a genuinely thin evidence base (2 faces, 1 photo) - reported honestly rather than padded with synthetic or unrelated faces.

Ethnicity/race is NOT graded here and never will be from this evidence: nobody photographed in a public street scene has a knowable, ground-truth self-identified race from visual inspection alone, and asserting one would be exactly the kind of invented precision this project's own intern-child-adult-detection manifest already declined to do for age/ethnicity. FairFace's race_output is recorded in full in every validation run (for visibility, and because FairFace is CC BY 4.0 - its output must carry attribution wherever shown) but never scored pass/fail. Age is graded only at the coarse 'not a child' level (age_bucket not in {0-2, 3-9, 10-19}), the same defensible-only-at-that-granularity judgement call as intern-child-adult-detection.

Faces are matched to ground truth by nearest detected face-centre to each entry's own expected_center_px, computed once against the real SCRFD detector at confidence 0.4 (det_thresh) - not by assuming a fixed model output order.

faces.note: Younger man, dark jacket over a red top, dark square sunglasses fully occluding the eyes, short dark hair. Unambiguously adult male by build, dress, posture and (visible) facial hair shadow.
Bearded man, tan/cream shearling-style coat, round amber-tinted sunglasses. Unambiguously adult male by build, full beard, dress and posture.
